title: A facile smartphone-based digital image colorimetric sensor for the determination of tetracyclines in water using natural phenolic compounds induced to grow gold nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8411-8419
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00091B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kraingkrai Ponhong, Tammanoon Nilnit, Chang Young Lee, Worapan Kusakunniran, Phoonthawee Saetear, Sam-ang Supharoek
A cost-effective smartphone-based digital image colorimetric sensor was developed to determine tetracyclines by inducing in situ growth of gold nanoparticles using naturally occurring phenolic compounds derived from para rubber tree bark waste.
